title: Within Your Agency and for Your Clients: A GHL Starting Plan

sections.label: 1 - AUTOMATE PROCESSES WITHIN YOUR AGENCY AND FOR YOUR CLIENTS
sections.note: Your post names no automation yet, so this is a starting plan built on two workflows; we swap in your own processes once you list them. The first runs on your own enquiries and inside every client sub-account.

sections.label: 2 - UNCOVER THE FULL POTENTIAL OF GHL'S AUTOMATION
sections.note: Your team knows GHL, so no tour of the builder. The full potential is the same rules running everywhere: a reply check before every follow-up and pipeline stages that move themselves, built once and loaded into your account and every client's.

sections.label: 3 - STRATEGIES FOR WORKFLOW EFFICIENCY AND CLIENT SATISFACTION
sections.note: Efficiency: one new-client tag does the onboarding nobody should copy by hand. Client satisfaction: a day-3 check-in, so you hear about a problem before it becomes a complaint.

sections.label: 4 - GUIDE YOUR TEAM IN IMPLEMENTING BEST PRACTICES
sections.note: How your team rolls out these two workflows and every one after them: saved in the snapshot, named and tagged one way, and tested on every branch before a client sees it.

nodes.label: 1 - New Lead Follow-Up in Your Agency: Instant Text, Team Alert
2 - Same Workflow in Every Client Sub-Account via Custom Values
nodes.notes: Booking, onboarding form and kickoff links are custom values, so one workflow loads into each client account and only the values change.

nodes.label: 3 - Did the Lead Reply? Checked Before Every Follow-Up
nodes.notes: Checked before every follow-up, so nobody who already answered gets chased.

nodes.label: 3a - Yes: No More Chasing, the Pipeline Moves to Replied
3b - No: Next Follow-Up, Then the Pipeline Moves to No Response
4 - Deal Won: Your Team Adds One new-client Tag, Welcome and Setup Tasks Follow
nodes.notes: Your team adds one tag when the deal closes; the welcome email, team alert and setup tasks follow.

nodes.label: 5 - Day-3 Check-In: Did the Client Reply?
5a - Yes: The Account Manager Answers the Same Day
5b - No: Silence Becomes a Call Task
nodes.notes: Ask before they complain: silence lands on someone's list, not a quiet, unhappy client.

nodes.label: 6 - Both Workflows in Your Agency Snapshot: Fix Once, Push to Every Client
7 - Naming and Tag Conventions Your Team Follows
8 - Test Contacts Through Every Branch Before Go-Live
nodes.notes: One test contact per branch, in your account and one client's, before anything goes live.

nodes.label: 9 - Delivered: First Two Workflows and Team Playbook
